goal: Test whether a complete multi-assertion Wiki module can preserve evidence closure and improve explicit required-fact availability over the same R0 retrieval base under a fixed visible-token budget.
constraints: Every Wiki assertion maps to exactly one active canonical Claim and resolvable evidence.
Claim bundles live only in the development experiment and must not create question-, domain- or Gold-specific production branches.
R0 and W2 use the same retrieval implementation, knowledge snapshot, question and 6000-token visible budget; only materialized Wiki consumption differs.
The model judge is diagnostic only. Required-fact conclusions must be checked against explicit answer text and frozen Claim coverage.
No new held-out Stage B or sealed Gold may be read.

gates.pass: M1 mechanism dependency is intact; selection and configuration hashes are frozen.
All six modules are materialized and consumable; every assertion has a surviving Claim and evidence; affected modules contain at least three assertions.
The multi-assertion transaction regression proves that one SUPERSEDES replacement preserves unrelated assertions and stableAddress.

All W2 requiredClaimIds and the selected materialized Wiki module are visible, W2 has no lower required-Claim coverage than R0 on any affected question, at least one affected question strictly improves, and all packs stay within 6000 estimated tokens.
Only after G0-G3: paired answers have 100% citation closure, no old forbidden fact, no unaffected hard regression, and W2 explicit required-fact coverage is not lower than R0.

stopRules: If G0-G3 fails, do not run online answers.
Do not tune production code with question IDs, domain keywords or Gold answer strings.
Do not overwrite first results; any repair is post-hoc and separately named.
Do not claim automatic Wiki formation from manually frozen development bundles.
